title: System Discovery & Package Fundamentals
purpose: Eight connected observations and bounded offline package exercises. Sequence is guidance, not an unlock system.
prerequisites: Bash quoting/statuses, files/permissions and deliberate guest-only sudo. Exact package-administrator image required.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 101.1, 101.2, 102.3, 102.4 partial; LPIC-2 v4.5 201.3 partial kernel querying. No complete objective or boot/storage recovery claim.

entries.description: Separate distribution, kernel, CPU and virtual device evidence.
materials: Display-only guest practice. Fresh lesson disk; no clipboard or networking. All new lessons require the exact package-administrator image; no older-image fallback.
Read-only tools do not teach installation. Only Lessons7/8 change the two project fixture packages. These are real guest transactions, not simulated package management.

Only trusted fixture archives; root-owned source/archives are protected against ordinary learner writes, not guest root. No maintainer scripts or services. Stop on failed guards, unexpected identities or conflicting package state.

Challenge setup only:
w=/home/learner/ll-discovery-1; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 65536
guard() { local links; test "$(pwd -P)" = /home/learner/ll-discovery-1 && test ! -L /home/learner/ll-discovery-1 && test "$(stat -c %U .)" = learner && links=$(sudo find . -type l -print -quit) && test -z "$links"; }; guard
unrelated() { dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}\t${Version}\t${db:Status-Status}\n' | awk '$1!="ll-discovery-data" && $1!="ll-discovery-report"'; }; unrelated > before.tsv; sudo sha256sum /etc/sudoers.d/learning-lab > sudo.before; id learner > learner.before; scope_ok() { guard && unrelated > after.tsv && cmp before.tsv after.tsv && sudo sha256sum -c sudo.before && id learner > learner.after && cmp learner.before learner.after; }; scope_ok
observations: Inventory with distribution, kernel, architecture, CPU count and a PCI ID; explain virtual hardware.
questions: Which values can change on another supported host?
limitations: Self-reviewed, unscored. No boot/storage recovery, module loading, library installation, USB tools, RPM, remote repositories or full objective claim. VM disks/reports are excluded from profile backups; Resume does not preserve RAM/jobs.

APT preview is not execution proof or a transaction lock. Recheck scope immediately before/after execution; any unrelated proposal stops this practice. Guest root can override checks. No automatic lesson execution.
cleanup: Retain observations before cleanup. After retaining evidence: guard && rm -- 'before.tsv' 'after.tsv' 'sudo.before' 'learner.before' 'learner.after' 'system.txt' 'cpu.txt' 'pci.txt' 'evidence.txt' && cd -- /home/learner && rmdir -- /home/learner/ll-discovery-1. Inspect existing exact members first; absent files are already clean on repetition. No recursion, force, globs or unrelated paths.
troubleshooting: Absolute /sbin paths avoid the learner PATH issue; (builtin) is not a module pathname.
A failed guard or unexpected package state requires investigation, not force, unrestricted repair or reuse of another workspace.
On interruption retain logs/disk. Inspect status only after a permitted clean boot; use confirmed Reset for unclean sessions, never force Resume.
